biography:
At Digital Realty, our team supports the largest global hyperscale and social media accounts with innovative and scalable digital infrastructure solutions tailored to evolving customer needs. As VP of Edge Sales, Global Accounts, my role focuses on driving customer success across colocation, interconnection, and cloud infrastructure, leveraging over 25 years of experience in the telecom and data center industries.  

Beyond customer solutions, I co-founded the Women’s Leadership Forum at Digital Realty and the Women’s Tech Forum, creating platforms that connect and empower women in cloud infrastructure. These initiatives reflect a commitment to fostering inclusion and equity across a traditionally male-dominated sector, while inspiring women to thrive in leadership and technical roles.
